title: create-list spec: one SharePoint list (<ListName>.list.json)
description: Written by the model, checked by scripts/list_lint.py, turned into an import file by scripts/build_list.py. Type names come from references/column-types.md.

name.description: Internal list name, also the Excel table and data-sheet name. ASCII PascalCase, at most 31 characters; list_lint.py checks the naming rules.

displayName.description: The list's name as users see it, any language.

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the user's language, for the setup text (e.g. th, en).

rows.description: Seed or sample data, one object per row keyed by column name. Types follow the data, so at least three.

sampleRows.description: true when rows are samples to delete after import, false when they are real seed data.

setup.description: User-facing text of the Setup sheet / Setup.md, in the user's language. English defaults are used for what is absent.

name.description: Internal name and file header. ASCII PascalCase; list_lint.py checks the naming rules.

default.description: Default value applied after import, or null.

choices.description: For choice and multichoice: the choices in display order. Otherwise null.

lookup.description: For lookup: the target list and column (internal names). Otherwise null.

postImport.description: Extra post-import steps in the user's language, appended to the generated ones.

notes.description: Free notes in the user's language, or an empty string.
